nom: PEACH & LILY Retinal For All Renewing Serum

avis.texte: I had used Paula's Choice 1% retinol serum for years. Thought I would try this...was not a fan. Seemed much milder. Just wasn't for me.
This really works. My forehead wrinkles have dmohsed by a lot!! I am in shock!

This may replace my tretinoin. After using it at night, I wake up with smooth skin that's still hydrated. With tret, I wake up with thirsty skin, even when I moisturize and slug on top. Peach and lily products are something else.

This product is a great way to start with anti-aging. I am trying to work my way up to using Tretinoin. I like this product because it's not irritating to my skin. I can't wait to see the long term results but I like it so far!

avis.titre: I was worried this would irritate my skin
avis.texte: I have rosacea and eczema AND allergies, and so I tend to be very cautious about trying more than just the most basic skincare items. However, I've had good experiences with other Peach and Lily products, and this was more reasonably-priced than many options my dermatologist had suggested. Since it's marketed for sensitive skin, I decided to give it a shot.I saw improvements immediately. And even more impressively, I didn't have a bad reaction! My forehead creases are drastically reduced, and my skin tone and texture are steadily improving. I started with once a week, and am now at twice a week.

One of my favorite products! For me, it works better than retinol's (vs retinal) of other types but without the irritation or dryness/flakiness. I don't need to use 7 days weekly bc 3-4 times weekly is enough - this saves me $$! No burning or stinging- just put it in after my toner, then on to the next step and off ya go. People compliment my skin all the time. This and Vitamin C serum/ rosehip oil (I alternate between those) have really helped fade my sun spots. Can we please get a hand cream with this stuff??

Need I say more? I am on my 4th bottle and it still amazes me how good this is each time I wake up the next morning. It's a staple in my routine and I can't be bothered to try anything else because it is THAT GOOD!
I am so impressed with this product. Only have used it for a couple of weeks but my face already has a smoother, fresher look. Will definitely buy again.
Wow! This retinal serum makes my skin more supple and younger looking,I've been an avid client of Peach n Lilly for so long. Thanks for making this Serum one of your best product!
Important part of my skin care routine is retinal, which makes skin look smooth and fabulous.

avis.titre: Love it, permanent routine holy grail!
avis.texte: I love this nighttime Retinoid treatment. It's so easy on the skin, I never have any problems with side effects. My skin loves this especially when paired with Peach & Lily's Glass Skin Refining Serum. A pair made for each other.
Love, love, love this. Really improved the texture of my skin on my nose and cheeks.

This is my 3rd bottle of this serum. I've tried other retinal serums, but I always come back to this one. The serum is bendable and zero irritation. I notice a difference in my skins complexion within the first week and it seems to plump or firm the skin as well.
I have several pretty large pores, and they are very, very slowly appearing smaller. Don't expect quick results, though.

I love peach ans lily products and the retinal did not dissapoint. Very gentle on my sensitive skin. I was down to my last pump and decided to open it to get every last bit out but was disappointed to find that the product is a small vial thats about a 1/4 of the size of the actual bottle itself.
As someone who has struggled with Retinols due to sensitive skin but needs it because of hormonal acne. This is great! This is my second purchase.

Directions are to start out using once a week, and have only used once, recently received this new item so cannot give a review but i do like the Texture so ill give a 4 star for texture, nice serum . Overall love their products
Serum excellent and Retinoid eye cream great and gentle recommend highly
This stuff is very gentle on skin and great for those with sensitivity!
Gentle enough that I use every night. I always have a backup bottle in my cupboard!

One month in I like it! It hasn't bothered my skin, the yellow tint helps me see where it is, and I like the bottle. My skin has been more soft, smooth, and healthy looking since adding this to my routine. Im only hoping it lasts, you can't tell how much is left because of the packaging.
I was at little worried but this is gentle and effective. I do this at night and the vit c in the morning. It is smoothing out my skin.
This serum made my skin sensitive around my nose area for a week but after that my skin adjusted. I use this every night. Not sure if I see any difference but I have not had any adverse effects .
This product is good for more sensitive skin. It has a good texture. This cream helps my skin look better and is fairly effective on lines and wrinkles.

I have tried a lot of other PL products and generally like most of them but never enough to actually write a review. This is the only retinoid I can use, and it really works. I even had to go off prescription Tret bc my skin could never get used to it. I use Retinal for All every day with no problem and my 49yo skin is looking amazing after just 3 weeks. I have fair skin, and no problem with the yellow color. I use one pump for my entire face and neck and the color completely dissipates. Also, like another review stated, there is no "straw" connected to the pump inside the bottle but that's bc it doesn't need one. When you first get it, just keep pumping, it takes a while at first.
What an improvement in my skin, I noticed the improvement within 2 weeks.

avis.titre: Fine but leaves a yellow cast
avis.texte: I've been using this for a month and I may see some very minor changes, but I have no way of knowing if that's because of this product or the other serums I started using at the same time. I took a star off because of the yellow color of this product. Fellow fair skin girls beware, this will leave a yellow cast on your skin, especially if you get it in your eyebrows or along your hairline and don't rub it in completely. Even when rubbing this in as much as humanly possible, I still look slightly jaundiced. I will only use this at night when I am home because of that I'm not sure if the product has to be yellow because of one of the ingredients, but I likely won't repurchase it based on that factor alone.
The Retinal For All Renewing Serum is a wonderful product. This product provides a gentle yet powerful product for anti aging!

I have never used retinol before so I wanted to try it out. So far I've noticed brighter skin but also with some skin purging in places I usually have break outs. I've started using it every other day and have been using it for about 3 weeks now. So far I'm impressed!!

This is such a great retinal for young adults in their 20's who are ready to take the next step in their skincare routine, but still need something gentle that won't cause a ton of peeling. As a tip, use a moisturizer on the sensitive skin under your eyes before putting retinal on your face. It will save you from any irritation there.
I love the texture of this retinal, and noticed a step up in efficacy from my last topical retinol. I experienced very little irritation, and I'm able to use the formula regularly.
Loving this. No purging period for me. I started slow. Never irritated my skin. I use it three nights a week now.

I just purchased the Retinal For All Renewing Serum because I loved the Pure Peach Retinoic Eye Cream so much. I am hoping it works just as well as the eye cream on my forehead lines. The directions say to use it once a week to start. I've started to use it twice a week. I can't wait to see how my lines look in a couple of months!

I just tried the Retinol for All serum and I will never use it again. I first noticed it left a yellow tint to my skin and figured it would go away once it soaked in. Then I noticed that it does not blend in well to clean skin and leaves yellow patches all over. Once I noticed this I tried to blend them in and/or wipe it off which then left yellow pilling. Lastly after I was done getting the yellow patches and pilling off my face I noticed that my hands were stained yellow. After 3 washes with lots of soap and water I can still see the yellow staining. This is such a disappointment because I am a huge fan of the Power Cocktail Lactic Acid Repair Serum.

Truly not anything you absolutely need. I love this brand but this product left a yellow tint on my skin and the texture is low key funky. Also the product dries at the opening of the pump and gets annoying to pump out.
Fine lines near my mouth and forehead have been reduced since I started using this 1 month ago. Also gentle and doesn't make face red.
Have been using this as preventative measure for aging. It helps with fine lines

I have been using this consistently now for about 3 months and I have just started using it every 3 days. I began with 1x/week, then 2 and now 3 and have not had a negative reaction thus far! It is extremely gentle and absorbs very quickly!

I have severe hormonal, acne, and my skin is extremely sensitive. I tend to research products at length before purchasing them. I've been using this product along with the Dermalogica vitamin c moisturizer and a Beautystat cleanser. I have noticed a vast difference in my skin in the last two weeks. While my acne hasn't cleared completely, I've noticed a significant reduction in the amount of acne, as well less inflammation overall.

Unfortunately, I did not do before and after photos but I have received positive comments on my skin since starting this product line. I also use it in my neck and have noticed an improvement in texture and appearance.
Gentle enough for my skin, woke up with a fresh face, love this for my daily routin, applcation was easy and mess free. Essence was perfect

avis.titre: One of my most important facial routines
avis.texte: Using this serum has cleared my skin and helped prevent acne and blemishes. It is gentle and works fantastic. It does leave a yellow residue, but I apply an hour or so before sleeping, which helps. Either way, it's a non-issue for me.
Perfect retinol serum. No irritation, no purge, my skin doesn't feel dry at all the next day. Did repurchase !
This is my second attempt to using a retinal serum. And I finally found one that works for my skin it's gentle non irritating but you can see the results!!
I love this product. After using this product, i noticed an improvement in my wrinkles and uneven skin texture.
I really like this retinol serum. No irritation and I have noticed my lines are becoming less apparent.
I have combination skin that is acne-prone. In my skincare routine, this one product has made the single greatest effect to skin texture, discoloration, and fine lines.
I've bought this a few times and it's definitely here to stay! My skin loveeees it and has never looked better!
Made fine lines less visible and I felt like it toned up my face in general.
I was always kind of afraid of retinal products but I trust Peach and Lily so I tried this one, and I will keep using it. It doesn't irritate my skin and does seem to make a difference in my skin.

avis.titre: Love it but difficult to get out.
avis.texte: I am on my 4th bottle but it is really difficult to get out. There is a pump but there is no stick to go into the bottle and the product is thick so you can't tip it upside-down. I took a stick from another bottle and put it on the tip of the pump and it is working but I still have to use a little spatula to get it out at times. This product should be in a jar.

My acne has significantly improved and my blackheads have been reduced. It feels a little cooling as I put it on. I use it about 3 times a week at night and in the morning my skin feels so smooth and refreshed. It doesn't smell strong and it's a pretty golden yellow color.

I LOVE the Retinal For All face serum and I make sure I never run out! I've been using this serum for almost 2 years now and it has helped my face tremendously. My complexion is brighter now, pores and fine lines are less noticeable, and even my dreaded "11" lines have improved! I've also noticed less breakouts, but when they do happen they seem to heal better and the dark spots fade faster. Overall my skin texture has improved so much since I began using this serum and I definitely recommend it to everyone. I never noticed any irritation with this product either which is a huge plus. The serum is bright yellow and quite thick, but it feels good on the skin and absorbs well. TRY THIS!!!
it is incredible. How smooth and light your skin will look the morning after you use this. 100000% recommend.
I have cystic acne and this helps tame flare-ups super fast! The price is not as high as some other comparable retinol products I've tried.

The ingredients are very good, and in just one month of use, I've seen positive results for the expression lines I already had before using it. My face looks wonderful since I started using the entire Peach and Lily line.

I've tried a few different retinol and retinal brands and this one is the best. It goes on so silky and soft, and has never caused irritation, even at its stronger percentage. I like that it has other supporting ingredients like ectoin and ceramides and best of all, the price point is more reasonable than others. Will keep getting!

avis.titre: The only minimizer I'll allow in my life
avis.texte: The Retinal is amazing and it minimizes my pores and fine lines. It's so gentle on my skin!! I'd highly recommend to anyone needing a skin refresh.
Love how gentle it is, I've repurchased multiple times and it makes my skin happy!

avis.titre: best product i have EVER used
avis.texte: i will be repurchasing this product over and over. My skin has never felt like this before. My skin looks flawless.

avis.titre: Got one and a spare so I never go without
avis.texte: I only use it every other night and my "11's" are noticeably reduced. One of the most effective non-prescription skincare products I have ever used.
A staple for me now - non-irritating and helps prevent breakouts!

Listen, this is your sign to STOP sleeping on this retinol! This formula is extremely gentle and effective and because it's encapsulated it releases into the skin a lot slower preventing peeling, dry skin on the face. This is youth in a bottle and I'm so happy I'm using it every single week several times as a 27-year old protecting my skin. 🙌:skin-tone-3:

avis.titre: I would buy this product myself
avis.texte: Received several of these as samples. Decided to give it a try since I had enough to do a month or more of use. I am so glad I did. First product that has made a noticeable difference in my melasma and I have bought all the expensive brands!

Peach & Lily has truly changed the game for me. I've struggled with my skin my whole life and turning 30 this year, I really wanted to get control of the situation and have some time between greasy, acne prone skin and wrinkles. Every product I've tried has felt wonderful, not given me a break out or rash, and has delivered on the promised result! Really really happy with every thing I've bought and the shipping has always been fast too! Can't say enough good things about Peach & Lily.

Love this product! I've been using it for a few weeks in combination with some other peach and lily products and I definitely see a different in my skin. My complexion is much brighter and my pores have shrunk! It feels great on the skin and isn't irritating at all.

When I clean my face at the end of the day, the cotton pad is yellow because of the yellow the retinal serum that I've applied the day before. This is concerning. Why do you put colors on your face products like blue in the Peptide Pro Moisturizer, green in the Matcha moisturizer, and then yellow in the Retinal serum? I really do not want to put something colored on my face. What happened to just white?

This is the most expensive product in my skincare routine, but it's worth it because it works. I'm on my second bottle and I've built up tolerance and use it every night with zero redness/irritation, and it keeps my skin so smooth! I've also noticed my neck lines have faded.

When I initially began to use this, I didn't notice much difference. Within a couple of weeks, I realized that the sebaceous filaments I have on my nose, on the sides of my nose, and under my mouth -- were sitting on top of the pores. Moreover, they were dry. When I figured out what was going on, I used an exfoliator and the reboot mask. Most of the filaments are 85% gone!

I've had a lot of sensitivity issues with retinol/retinoid products, so I was a bit wary of trying this product. But I'm now using it 3 times a week and have had NO issues with skin reactivity! It's also giving me clear results - my skin is super soft when I wake up in the morning, and it has definitely helped with uneven tone/texture. Very happy I took a gamble on this product!
I have been using this for a couple weeks now, so far not much difference on my skin. Still hopeful though

As someone with sensitive skin, I have been looking for a potent but gentle retinal serum. Retinal For All Renewing Serum has given me no trouble whatsoever--no itching and burning or harsh interactions with other products. I have been able to work it into my (already multi-step) routine without having to worry about the comfort or safety of my skin. Too, I am only 21. . . but I am seeing results! My skin is so much smoother. I totally recommend this product.
This is really great stuff! Gentle and not aggravating to my super sensitive skin. I was nervous about starting retinol due to my excessively sensitive skin but once a week - and no issues so far!
Does not glide on your skin well, needing more product to do the job. Caused me to break out. Also low retinol. Bought it on sale but wouldn't recommend or buy again.

avis.titre: FINALLY!! I waited for something like this for so long
avis.texte: I love how this retinal is pro sensitive skin, doesn't leave your skin cracking, it's lightweight, and most importantly it does what it needs to do. If you're like me with; enlarged pores, blemishes and some dark spots here and there. THIS IS FOR YOU!!
I love this retinol. Within a week my skin was smoother and wrinkles looked less defined. Love how gentle it is, no irritation on my combo rosacea skin.

avis.titre: Fantastic, effective, gentle - will repurchase again
avis.texte: I use this twice per week, and it's phenomenal! I have sensitive skin, and it hasn't once caused irritation! I also feel like my acne-prone skin has calmed down. If I see an emerging zit and use this product at night, I notice a difference by morning. I don't really have wrinkles yet, so I can't speak to that. But my skin does look generally more radiant after using this product. 10/10 would recommend.
Most gentle retinal with amazing results! You won't regret it!

Can I just say this product is AMAZING!? I use this on Mondays, and Wednesdays as part of my routine and see a notable difference the next day. My skin is brighter, and more even. I'm not someone who sticks to a skincare routine, i tend to fall off the wagon at some point but I am hooked. This is also perfect for someone with super duper sensitive skin like me!
This is the first time i bought a retinol that actually made a difference. On the next morning my skin was lighter more pumped! I really did not believe it

I've been using this product for over a year and it's the only product that helps prevent and heal my acne! I continue to repurchase because my sensitive/dry skin loves it so much. Pair is with a good moisturizer and your skin will love you for it!
Along with other dark spot treatment products from P&L, this serum has helped to lighten the dark spots on my face and reduce hyperpigmentation, as well as make my skin look firm and bright.
Love how this feels on skin and also how skin looks after using. No irritation either!
I've only have used it 2 times in two weeks since it says to start off once a week. Didn't break out or anything so far liking it. I do recommend.

Retinal is typically a long game so I have yet to see huge results as I don't use it too often. I do love the easy application, I never feel like I've got too much product. It blends nicely with the other products during my night time routine. I Hope to see some improvement on dark spots in the near future.

avis.titre: Peach & Lily Products are the best!
avis.texte: This is one of my favorite products of all the P&L goodness. Makes my skin soft and hydrated, and works perfectly w/Glass Refining Serum. Perfect duo!

avis.titre: Yes! Buy this and see results.
avis.texte: I have been using the peach and Lily retinol renewing serum for about six months. I typically spend at least four times more for my skin care products and have found this particular retinol to be extremely effective without irritating my skin.

avis.titre: If you want tighter smoother skin!
avis.texte: I can see an immediate change when I wake up in the morning. My skin is softer and tighter! I use it every 3 nights and pair it with the overnight star night cream.

avis.titre: I have been using this pr
avis.texte: I have been using this product for 7 days and so far its been great with no reactions.

Got her during the ulta sale and im obsessed! I have very sensitive skin & acne prone but this has not caused a breakout at all. My skin looks smooth like a baby bottom! Used 3 nights in a row before reviewing
Feels very gentle and light compared to other retinal products i've used before!
Love this retinol! I have super sensitive and dry skin and this formula does not dry out my skin or cause irritation. I have noticed an improvement with my skin texture, fine lines, and acne.

i have been using the dermalogica microfoliant for years, but i thought i would give this a try and it is amazing! the granules are slightly bigger than dermalogica, which i liked and makes my skin feel really clean and fresh. will definetly buy again!

I have hormonal acne so it didnt completely rid me of deep acne but i did see visable improvements in my skin in all other ways. It lasts me around 3 months. I use only at night a pea size. Ive used it for 9 months now—it is a definite rebuy for me.
I love this product I've been using it for a bit now and WOWWW I have alot of pigmentation under my mouth because I would always lick my lips and this is a game changer.
Haven't tried it for too long but it hasn't broken me out or anything yet. That's a good sign right? Seems very gentle. I'll keep using it.
This has made my skin so shiny, soft and bright. Seriously one of the best products I have ever used on my skin

It's too soon to say about the results, but it doesn't freak out my sensitive skin and doesn't even lead to flaking if I follow the once-a-week schedule - more than that and I will shed a little. It is a really nice texture and doesn't have a terrible smell like some retinols do.
But maybe because three weeks isn't enough time … or … my skin is too old
Goes on well. Scentless. Good coverage. Not astringent and no stinging. Hopeful!
I feel like this product is working but it doesn't apply super easily. It has a firmer texture and doesn't spread very easily over the skin.
This retinol is the best I've tried and held me wake up to beautiful skin.

I have definitely seen a difference in the texture of my skin after a couple of months of using this serum. I started slow with one application per week, then two, and now I use it about every other night. My skin was slightly irritated the very first time, but has been fine since then. I'm going to try the lactic acid serum when this runs out and see which one I prefer.
I have only been using this for a few weeks so I haven't seen much for results yet.

avis.titre: If you think your skin is too sensitive for powerful retinoi
avis.texte: I'm so happy that there's a powerful over the counter retinoid available (retinal! amazing) that doesn't totally mess up my skin. And the results are SO good, my skin looks smooth af. I use it every other day to every 3 days, depending on what it feels like my skin needs and can tolerate, but this is such a gentle but powerful retinoid. Differin sensitized my skin so much, I thought I wouldn't be able to use a strong retinoid, but it turns out that isn't true! :) As long as it's this one!

I can tell a difference in my skin with this product. I do not have sensitive skin and it was not at all irritating for me. Other retinol products have caused minor irritation so it seems like this is much gentler even for those who might have sensitive skin. This is something I will re-purchase and has value in my skincare routine. I notice smaller pores (not drastically but I think they look better) and overall more evenness.

I was using Kiehls Retinol for months and switched to Peach and Lily recently because i like that its vegan and cruelty free (and the price is better). Let me tell you...after using the Retinal once, the bumpy, uneven texture next to my eyes smoothed out in one use! My pm routine: hydrobubble cleanser, glass skin serum, retinal, ultra plush rich cream. Amazing. I am sold on this product!

I have quite a few favorite P&L products and I wanted to love this one so bad but it turns your skin yellow. No matter how much you rub it in, the egg yolk yellow doesn't go away. Even after washing my face the next morning my skin still looks yellow. It also stains fabric

I saw a difference immediately after applying. I use this at night time before I went to bed and it was instantly hydrating and firming, no redness no irritation. I am so glad I came across this incredible company Peach & Lily. I highly recommend this. I saw Insta results. I will keep using this twice a week with all the other products I use from this company. So gentle, I am so happy with this. !! I will definitely be buying for a lifetime!!
